title: One Car Photo Three Sizes
tests: Tests delivering three distinct aspect-ratio adaptations of one source while keeping the complete subject in every version.

faults.what: The photo has been recreated rather than simply resized and padded: wheel details, the rear badge, license plate and some background details visibly differ from the attachment.
The stories image is slightly taller and narrower than the requested 9:16 ratio.

judge.summary: Three separate padded images keep the whole red car visible, but unnecessary changes to the original photo and a slightly incorrect stories ratio need fixing.

must_haves.item: Three separate images are delivered, rather than one collage.
must_haves.why: Three distinct output images are shown.

must_haves.item: The three frames have ratios of 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 respectively.
must_haves.why: The first two frames match square and 4:5, but the third is slightly narrower than 9:16.

must_haves.item: Every version shows the same red hatchback from the attached photo.
must_haves.why: All three depict the recognizable red hatchback from the same viewpoint.

must_haves.item: The complete car, including roof, wheels and both ends, is visible in every version.
must_haves.why: The roof, both visible wheels, and front and rear ends fit within every frame.

must_haves.item: The car retains its original proportions and appearance in all versions.
must_haves.why: Overall proportions are close, but wheel, badge and plate details have visibly changed.

must_haves.item: Any padding is a blurred version of the source photo, and no version contains added text.
must_haves.why: The padding visibly uses blurred photographic content matching the scene, with no added text overlays.
